spells.fillerNotes: As the pike offers fewer weapon skills than most other weapons, the only choice in skill selection is between the paragon skills Cold Dragon and Green Dragon. Of these skills, Green Dragon is by far the stronger skill, as it ignores collision with enemies, offers a dash, and deals massive burst damage against units and heroes alike. In contrast, Cold Dragon forces users to run forward for its duration, deals a weaker control effect against heroes, and has somewhat mediocre damage. - wiki

builds.name: Full Agility
builds.summary: High burst damage; has to be used carefully since you die very fast. Viable if played properly. House datapoint: about 16k damage on the ultimate, regular medium gear.

builds.name: Full Armour / Full Health / Mix Health-Armour
builds.summary: Currently the most viable path - lets you last a lot longer in close melee combat, which lets you open formations and play more aggressive in combination with your units. This build is mostly used.

techniques.name: Animation canceling
steps: Training room: try roll-canceling, dismount-canceling and blocking on every skill to learn which are cancelable.
techniques.rhythm: Amya: EVERY CLASS CAN DO IT! - Blocking is the primary cancel; roll canceling interrupts full spells, dismounts, and creates movement otherwise impossible. Costs extra stamina.

techniques.name: Active blocking
steps: it can be BROKEN and stagger you
techniques.rhythm: Don't get "Block checked" - Being an active blocker prevents undesired skills landing on you.

techniques.name: Horse-whistle CC immunity
steps: Time the whistle on the enemy CC
you take damage but no CC
techniques.rhythm: bugs out with PIN/LOCK skills, so care

techniques.name: Walk into braced units
steps: Walk (don't sprint) into their minimal range
techniques.rhythm: brace damage scales with your speed towards them - For braced units like Forte, Halberds, Phalanx - niche: enemy hero outnumbered, unaware or afk.

techniques.name: Right-click horse-charge
steps: charge into the formation, staggering on contact
techniques.rhythm: opens enemy formations before you dive - Costs no stamina and adds speed on the dismount while staggering the enemy; can stagger cav or dismount heroes off their horse. Amya calls this out specifically for Pike.

techniques.name: Pike Kebab (pin-and-displace)
steps: Land the 2nd-stage ultimate pin (Green Dragon charged 0.5-1s, the knockdown tier)
follow up with a post-Ultimate "press again" stage on Sky/Wandering/Water Dragon
shove the downed hero into position (your unit block, off a wall) before they recover
techniques.rhythm: displace a downed hero into your unit block or off a ledge before they recover - BirdOfQin, Amya's CB Library #Tips-Tricks-Forum, 2024-10-09: "Trick to displace people after using your pin 2nd-stage ultimate on Pike. This is very good to bring people inside your unit/team/down from wall after they are cc'd or you have your 2nd stage ultimate ready and a hero is passing by unaware of what could happen to him."

gameplay.text: The pike is a long polearm which grants its users excellent mobility. However, the pike is a fairly complicated weapon to use and is less effective against enemy units than many other weapon classes.
When fighting hero's as a pike it is your goal to knock the enemy down and land your ultimate. While learning this class you should always try to be as mobile and flexible as possible.

roleLabel: Pike users are extremely maneuverable and chain low cooldown skills to outfight the enemy.

positioning.intro: Where to be during a fight:

bullets.text: Hero-duel and pick class first, anti-unit second - less effective against enemy units than most other weapon classes, so don't try to anchor a line or hold a blob.
Operate at the edges of a fight: chase, dismount, and finish enemy heroes rather than sit in the middle. Never stationary - MOVEMENT IS KEY.

bullets.lead: Right-click on horse to open formations:
bullets.text: stagger cav or dismount heroes before diving in - the charge costs no stamina and adds speed on the dismount.
using skills can stack buffs and change the effects of other skills - normal attacks add a Strong as a Storm effect, increasing damage by 4%, stacking up to 3 times.
Use your dismount to stun hero's mix in auto attacks into your combos roll and block to cancel animations and never be stationary as pike. MOVEMENT IS KEY!
Learn your combos and the little tricks as shown in the videos down bellow to outplay your enemy.
knock the enemy down, then land your ultimate.

bullets.lead: Green Dragon beats Cold Dragon as the paragon pick:
bullets.text: ignores collision, has a dash, bigger burst vs both units and heroes.
Sky Dragon's stage-3 spin can break soft gates quickly.

bullets.lead: Wandering Dragon phases through units on every stage:
bullets.text: useful for repositioning behind an enemy unit or gaining separation mid hero-fight.
Amya (NEED Piercing pen/Piercing), wiki (aim for piercing damage and piercing armour penetration first), and house (Wazneeplus: "Piercing dmg/pen") all land on the same priority.

full-agility Pike on regular medium gear hits about 16k damage on the ultimate - "There isn't really anythging that works well for pike on the new armors", read as neither Windrider nor Earthshatter pulling its weight, consistent with Amya's guide only recommending a well-reforged Carnifex over either special set.

items.name: Absolute Courage
items.effect: Using [Wandering Dragon] grants 1 stack of [Dragon's Courage], reducing damage taken by 5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. At max stacks, [Water Dragon], [Cold Dragon], and [Green Dragon] will ignore 50% of the target's defense values for 7 seconds. Cost: 3 Rune Power.

items.name: Splendid Spear
items.effect: [Green Dragon] does not need to be fully charged to achieve the damage and Knockup effects of a 1-second charge. Cost: 3 Rune Power.

items.name: Seven Charges
items.effect: Each time the third stage of [Wandering Dragon], [Water Dragon], or [Sky Dragon] is used, the cooldown of your [Ultimate] is reduced by 2 seconds. Cost: 2 Rune Power.

armorRunes.intro: This isn't by any means the ONLY build, runes should be adapted to your play-style and little preference BUT it is a "overall best" build for the people who don't want to spend time theory crafting or just want something to copy!

runes.effect: Damage taken from Units is reduced by 20%. When Health falls below 50%, damage taken from Units is additionally reduced by 10%.

runes.name: Tempered Armor
runes.effect: Damage taken from Units is reduced by 20%. Upon taking damage from Units, damage taken from Units is additionally reduced by 15% for 5 seconds (triggers once every 15 seconds).

runes.name: Avalon's Blessing
runes.effect: Restores 2% of max Health per second while inside an allied Supply Point.

runes.name: Divine Right
runes.effect: When casting a non-ranged [Damage] skill, all defence values are increased by 25% for 8 seconds. (14/05/2026 rework, news/1767)

runes.name: Hwarang Resolve
runes.effect: Damage taken is reduced by 10%; while in Knockback, Knockdown, Knockup, and Concussed states, damage taken is additionally reduced by 5% (buffed to 25% by the 14/05/2026 patch, news/1767; the Chaos re-issue Art of Stillness is back to 5%).

runes.name: Dragonblood Bath
runes.effect: All defences are increased by 3.5%. When Health is below 50%, all defences are increased by an additional 2.5% for 5 seconds (triggers once every 30 seconds).

runes.name: Martyr's Glory
runes.effect: Increases maximum Health by 5%; upon death, nearby allies instantly recover 10% of their maximum Health.

items.note: Take faster bandage then it's full preference

runes.name: Relentless Crusade
runes.effect: Movement speed is increased by 6%. Upon death, the movement speed of surrounding allies is increased by 8% for 10 seconds.

runes.name: Competitive Edge

runes.name: Numbing Remedy
